notes.title: What we’ve been working on lately… #5
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35994584/610e53315a0671460dd07cb8ce879eee36c9ed56.png[/img]

[h1]Samurai![/h1]

It’s been a while since our last update, but rest assured – we’ve been fully immersed in some exciting developments that we’ll share with you in the coming weeks. And while we can't reveal everything at once, we'll be slowly spilling the beans.

To back this up, here’s a glimpse into what we’ve been up to recently. Ready to dive in? [b]Let's take a journey together[/b]!

[h2]Stealth System[/h2]

First off, we've implemented an exciting new stealth system that’s aimed at enhancing your gameplay experience. With the press of a button, [b]you can slip into stealth mode[/b], revealing the enemy’s area of control and their vision.

[previewyoutube=KYmBTO7vXhU;full][/previewyoutube]

Just imagine sneaking past foes, using every bit of the bush and every shadowy hideout to your advantage... The thrill of moving undetected is at your fingertips!

And while in stealth mode, you can silently take down isolated enemies or even ambush them. But be cautious - if your target is too close to their ally, you can get ambushed yourself. Thrilling, isn't it?

[h2]Continuous Combat Flow[/h2]

Next, we’ve reworked our combat system to feature a continuous timeline. This change brings in a lot of depth and new possibilities (more about that in the future ;)).

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35994584/4c5a359dc315bb7a8d131983b077e545cd0fbe37.png[/img]

Each character now has a frequency that determines how often they will take their turn, and the order can be shifted both left and right within the timeline. It simply provides [b]a more dynamic and strategic combat experience[/b].

[h2]Hoist the sail![/h2]

To wrap things up, we have a special treat for you – a teaser for [b]a brand-new level[/b] that’s yet to be revealed. We won’t give away too much, but let’s just say we hope none of you suffer from seasickness! ;)

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35994584/57b31472f9104424c0e023fca417dd4ffa7154de.png[/img]

[h2]Finally…[/h2]

We really appreciate your patience and that’s why we want to show you that we’re making steady progress with the game. To keep up with all the latest updates and sneak peeks, [b]join our Discord and follow us on social media[/b]. 

[url=https://discord.gg/MKrxqQ6KQN][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35994584/c4c51a7246abc6e04e52aef35cc833f2e90045aa.png[/img][/url]

We're excited to share more with you soon. Stay tuned, Warriors – the best is yet to come!

Cheers,
Another Angle Games

notes.title: What we’ve been working on lately… #4
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35994584/621629c34aa045275736b670eeb41588dd88df5f.png[/img]

[h1]Samurai! [/h1]

We're super pumped to be back and ready to spill the beans on what we've been up to lately. Hope you're just as stoked about these new developments as we are!

In today's devlog we'll be focusing on updates related to the combat system. We've poured our hearts and souls into polishing this aspect of the game because… Hey, [b]we're gamers too[/b], and we know how crucial it is to the whole experience.

[h2]Co-op Skills[/h2]

Let's kick things off with Co-op Skills. We see this mechanic as absolutely pivotal in the game, rooted in the connections between characters. These relationships will evolve based on player choices, the progression of events, and more. And when those links hit the sweet spot, get ready for some seriously epic special moves!

Check out the [b]sneak peek video[/b] below and let us know what you think!

[previewyoutube=KxK0sBjdi1o;full][/previewyoutube]

[h2]Environment[/h2]

Now, let's talk about [b]shaking up combat with environmental interactions[/b]. We've introduced something that we call Reactive Objects. Picture this: you're in the heat of a battle, there's a barrel or something else nearby, and suddenly, bam! It explodes and changes the course of the battle!

[previewyoutube=lXMjORG7z1U;full][/previewyoutube]

But wait, there's more! We've been fiddling with the destruction system, [b]adding depth to it[/b]. Factors like the source and magnitude of force used on items affect how they react, so it's gonna make battles feel even more intense and satisfying.

[previewyoutube=59zl_GJxjo4;full][/previewyoutube]

[h2]Utilize every advantage[/h2]

And guess what?[b] We're not stopping there[/b]. Say hello to Interactable Items. We're throwing these into the mix to spice up the combat even more. These items may be scattered across the battlefield or stored in our inventory, if acquired beforehand.

[i]inb4 - Yes, grenades are present in Shadow of the Road[/i]!

[previewyoutube=As99tJq4Rbw;full][/previewyoutube]

Plus, who hasn't seen those epic action movie scenes where the hero, armed with nothing but their fists, turns anything they can find into a weapon? Trust me, sometimes improvisation can be a lifesaver and [b]a complete game changer in a fight[/b]!

Occasionally, you'll snag weapons dropped by enemies, but there's also the wild card factor: sometimes an item might just activate on its own, shaking up the whole environment! 

[previewyoutube=siBPsPHr7GQ;full][/previewyoutube]

[h2]In the end! [/h2]

To wrap things up, [b]big thanks for checking out this devlog[/b]! We hope that you like the updates and where Shadow of the Road is headed. Stay tuned because we're aiming to chat with you more often as time goes on!

Oh, and don't forget to hit that follow button on Shadow of the Road's socials - Facebook, Instagram, X (Twitter), and TikTok. Plus, join our Discord crew for the inside scoop on upcoming beta testing and to shoot the breeze with fellow gamers!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35994584/ac9c98442f49dcdbbba4cab65f0e6fd92ff34766.png[/img]

[h1]Greetings, Samurai! [/h1]

We're back with another exciting peek into the world of Shadow of the Road! As always, we're thrilled to have you on this journey with us, and we've got some great updates to share that we believe will make your wait for the game more enjoyable.

Today, we'd like to discuss the three primary aspects we are currently focusing on. Let's dive into the first one!

[h2]Combat Animations[/h2]

As you've probably noticed, we've been hard at work improving the finer details of our combat system. They may seem like small things, but they have a significant impact on the outcome.

[previewyoutube=USoLAiweckk;full][/previewyoutube]
[previewyoutube=AcYkIrTLYrQ;full][/previewyoutube]

The newest animations will add a new layer of immersion to the game, making combat feel more fluid and responsive. It's still a proof of concept, but there's a high likelihood that it will find its way into the game. Visual effects are impressive, right?

[h2]Verticality[/h2]

What’s more, we’re enhancing verticality in combat! We’ve got some exciting ideas in the pipeline, including the ability to throw enemies at one another and more intricate environmental hazards. Imagine being able to use the surroundings to your advantage, like shoving an opponent onto a barricade or impaling them on spikes!

The possibilities are endless, and we can't wait for you to explore them. Just take a look at the WIP version of this feature! Looks painful… 

[previewyoutube=SC1X1oJE2nc;full]Wideo #2 - Zepchnięcie na beczki[/previewyoutube]

[h2]Let it snow, let it snow…[/h2]

And here's a little treat for you, gamers. We're crafting the next landscape in our game and we're eager to show you a few screenshots to whet your appetite. The winter holidays are approaching quickly, so we already have snow on our minds. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35994584/8c826bf20b899d94d386f5b14a965698d7c729eb.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35994584/852d3b04a087027b5f52c356c54074467f304f5c.png[/img]

We haven't shown much of the winter environment yet, so this could be your first peek at the frosty challenges that you can expect. We've got some stunning visuals in store, and we can't wait for you to dive into this world.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35994584/0f9b70256770e0f628656efe59479b50c33573b6.png[/img]

[h2]That's it for today![/h2]

Our goal is simple - we want to make this game an unforgettable experience, and we're thrilled to have you along for the ride. Keep an eye out for future devlogs and, as always, feel free to share your thoughts and feedback with us. 

Your input is invaluable in shaping the game into something truly special. And if you want to stay up-to-date with everything and actively participate in the creation process, join our Discord server!

Thank you for your unwavering support! Stay tuned for more exciting updates on Shadow of the Road…

Cheers

notes.title: Let’s talk about the Initiative System…
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35994584/119bc4fd0ec7073497c09f23726bf5a6a9ef3753.png[/img]

[h1]Samurai Warriors![/h1]

Recently, we treated you to [url=https://steamcommunity.com/games/1173980/announcements/detail/3732977475613248390]an interview with our sound magician[/url], and today we're bringing you a devlog straight from the heart of [b]our game development process[/b]!

Have you ever heard of an initiative system? It's an incredibly vital component in many turn-based RPGs! And the situation is [b]no different in Shadow of the Road[/b], where it plays a fundamental role. In simple words -  its primary task is to determine the order in which characters get to make their moves.

Let us share a bit of the history of [b]how this system has evolved in our game[/b]… 

[h2]In the past…[/h2]

At first, we had a [b]very “XCOM-like” approach[/b] where players could make moves with all characters in any order (and multiple times within their turn, using available action/movement points). In other words, the player would switch between characters, take actions, end their turn, and after that the game would switch to AI which would act similarly.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35994584/e2e05ad642dfe6ab8058466a810637d1592fb13c.png[/img]

We showcased this combat system [b]at PAX in 2020[/b]. And while it served its purpose, we felt that our game needed something more… Something deeper! We needed a system that would allow players to anticipate enemy moves, analyze situations, and have full influence on what is happening on the battlefield!

[h2]So now! [/h2]

The current iteration of the system [b]draws its inspiration from samurai battles[/b], where it's crucial to observe everything and make decisions that significantly impact the course of the clash.

[b]The core of this mechanic revolves around character initiative. [/b]

All characters participating in the battle are [b]sorted based on their initiative values[/b] and the one with the highest value starts the whole action. Default initiative values are predefined, but can change as the game develops. Several factors influence the status, such as an initiative penalty for taking damage and side effects.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35994584/1c290d04a129b29f061505642629f140dccdc40e.png[/img]

By introducing this system, we were able to incorporate [b]more combat mechanics[/b] that enhance its depth. 

The main innovation here is [b]delayed attacks[/b]!

These attacks are more effective, but carry a risk of failure. A delayed attack is carried out as a new element on the timeline. So the character initiating it cannot move and automatically ends their turn. If they are attacked before executing the attack, it will be interrupted.

This system also operates in rounds, with [b]each unit making one move per round[/b]. 

[h2]Unfortunately… [/h2]

Introduced changes also have some drawbacks that make this solution less than perfect. Notable issues include:

⚔️ Delaying attacks by a fixed value can lead to situations where nobody on the battlefield can counter or interrupt them. We attempted to solve this by delaying attacks based on factors like the number of characters, but this fix won’t be good enough.

⚔️ Time axis shifts are inconsistent. We couldn't find a solution that would allow us to predictably and fairly move a unit, for example, to the next round. A character that received a high amount of damage would end up at the end of the queue in a given round.

⚔️ The chance of having a negative initiative value. After receiving a sufficient amount of damage, a unit might have a negative initiative value, which isn't considered a valid value. While we could theoretically try to soften this effect by increasing base values, it wouldn't eliminate the entire problem.

But guess what…? These issues prompted us to work on another version of the system! 

[h2]What the future holds…[/h2]

Treat this like a small sneak peek, but… 

In previous systems, the gameplay was divided into rounds in which action points and character movement reset at the beginning of each subsequent turn. The new system will have an additional dimension, and we will be abandoning the concept of rounds. However, we don't intend to reveal too much just yet, as there's more to come. 

[b]Rest assured, everything is continuously evolving![/b]

[h2]Stay tuned![/h2]

To stay in the loop regarding our progress, come join our Discord community! And once again, thank you for being a part of this incredible journey!

[i]Best regards

notes.title: What we've been working on lately...
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35994584/6d254d25e9c0da636cb4a69caf6b620b95dce76c.png[/img]

[h1]Warriors! [/h1]

It's great to be back and we are truly grateful for the warm reception of our previous devlog, which focused on the gore aspect of the game (by the way, if you haven't checked it out yet - [url=https://steamcommunity.com/games/1173980/announcements/detail/3656408671613681090]here it is[/url]).

Today, we would like to [b]share some new exciting updates[/b] that we have been working on lately. Consider this as the first of many dev diaries to come in the future. We want you to know what is happening with the game, so you’ll be one of the first to hear about the latest milestones! 
Lighting

[h2]Let’s start with something important![/h2]

We have been experimenting with [b]different lighting techniques[/b] to enhance the overall atmosphere of Shadow of the Road. We strive for global illumination to be believable and applicable to both characters and environments. 

We believe that the right lighting can help players truly [b]immerse in the game's world[/b] and amplify the sense of danger lurking around every corner.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35994584/f08348c511486b6240a64ffcd107454491b3e21a.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35994584/d915cc9064726a4300cf5eff8e6738932e241b01.png[/img]

It's the work of the tiniest details, but worth every drop of sweat!

[h2]Verticality[/h2]

Next, we want to give you [b]a glimpse of something exciting[/b]. For example, take a look at one of the stages. What makes this encounter particularly interesting is… The abundance of ladders, adding a unique multi-level dimension to the fight!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35994584/1b645c3d5f228d3b8d859dcc1dfc7aa31ba08c71.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35994584/c31ff0e2e60a0c749a2ce7ad6f18015c713bf538.png[/img]

[b]Yes, fight[/b]! We must let you know that this is where you’ll find dangerous enemies, so you better watch out and get ready. Samurai must be strong, but also wise - remember to use the environment around you! Get ready for intense vertical combat!

[h2]New skills[/h2]

Another interesting thing we want to introduce you to is a new skill called "Glacial Fangs". We won't reveal all the details just yet, but we can show you [b]how spectacular this attack is in motion[/b]. 

[previewyoutube=tfm89-RPC6w;full][/previewyoutube]

[b]Stay tuned for more updates[/b], and believe us - you’ll be able to use many more thrilling skills in the game. Enemies will be terrified! 

[h2]Something extra…[/h2]

As a little surprise and a token of our gratitude for being with us, we would like to show you something exciting and truly satisfying. You see, during the development of Shadow of the Road, we've been having an absolute blast, and the fruits of our labor have seamlessly merged into captivating elements that [b]breathe life into the very fabric of the game[/b].

[previewyoutube=NjxXyv2HY8A;full]BRIDGE VIDEO[/previewyoutube]

For example - let's take a moment to admire [b]the way this bridge is generated[/b]. Trust us when we say, we can't help but feel an overwhelming sense of pride due to how incredible it looks!

[h2]Till next time![/h2] 

Before we wrap up, we want to invite all of you to [b]follow us on our social media platforms[/b] - Twitter, Facebook, TikTok, and Instagram to stay up-to-date with the latest news and announcements. 

Above all, we highly encourage you to [url=https://discord.gg/eJk8Aq62WB]join our Discord server[/url], where everything happens first! Thank you for your continued support and enthusiasm.

Warm regards
Another Angle Games

notes.title: New locations, quests & team management
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35994584/62d00c03092f0935f359b68f0639487a989f8779.jpg[/img]

The last ten weeks have been incredibly hard on us. We have been working on an update that is going to concern exploration and the narrative. 

[b]## Narrative updates [/b]

We have successfully managed to complete our first gameplay that is over an hour long and consists not only of enemy encounters and skirmishes, but is also heavily focused on the story.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35994584/f1453478e34e23aa569488310c6430eb981da57f.jpg[/img]

We have added a dialogue system that gives us different options on how to progress on multiple levels. The aspect that we are especially proud of is the fact that any member of your team can take part in a conversation - not just Satoru, the protagonist. As mentioned before, the choices you make will influence different aspects of the story - including relationships between characters and the narrative in general.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35994584/5fab16fabd9b66d02b17b2582b2c93ffa35d5d95.jpg[/img]

We have also designed alternative paths that can be taken by the player and these actually influence much more than just dialogues. The mechanics we use in combat, the enemies we encounter, and the way the story unfolds are all going to depend on which path we decide to follow.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35994584/7819be7f0ba21213d1164d069656e3165a69b1c9.jpg[/img]


[b]## Barks  [/b]

We want to make sure that all characters are aware of their surroundings and that they're not indifferent to everything happening around them. Barks are something that we want to use to cover this aspect in Shadow of the Road. The characters are going to make comments on different events, locations etc. in real-time, helping us understand their views and personalities.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35994584/7ece8c181e16e62559f9937151fef3b2f36cf20e.jpg[/img]

[b]## New locations - sneak peek[/b]

Beautiful hills

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35994584/209ac05c20343b4ac5f02c111b9769c1956c1d24.jpg[/img]

Graveyard and a shrine

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35994584/ed4a6961b13e46ea93fa8c45703bfc9214ea1d4f.jpg[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35994584/7479e60a41212be4c3846f13d52afa721c43c8be.jpg[/img]

Caves

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35994584/26a54b254cb9e6f0b87c466e4f963bc6465d50c3.jpg[/img]

[b]## Inventory etc.[/b]

Here's our first ever look at the inventory. What's important is that weapons can be enchanted to add some new features, a crafting system is also going to be in place and every character is going to have a separate equipment stash that is going to be manageable outside of combat.


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35994584/0fe4e9d0b7111354c4e51bb92bf847684c11885a.jpg[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35994584/e9117389b23b49bf69245a78bc51f2c2ad3478e8.jpg[/img]

[h2]
[b]## New Mechanics[/b][/h2]

[h3][b]# resurrection[/b][/h3]

It's better to stay alive if you have the choice. Luckily not everything is lost - as long as at least one of your team members is alive during combat, you should mostly be fine. Of course the characters that have been knocked out get brought back after the battle, but we have a very special revive mechanic that we're planning to share with you in the next update.

[img]https://media.giphy.com/media/RK4lpcv9T1G5LQjnbn/giphy.gif[/img]

[h3][b]# opportunity attack[/b][/h3]

This is a passive skill called Opportunity Attack. Exiting any of the red fields will result in the opponent performing an extra free attack. This is a penalty for disengaging from combat with some of the melee foes. The visual info & feedback from such actions is still in development.

[img]https://media.giphy.com/media/dZjN3fruXNLa2Fvrzf/source.gif[/img]


[h3][b]Join our discord server & see what will happen next![/b][/h3] 
Your insights are invaluable for us and it helps us to deliver something extraordinary.

[url=http://bit.ly/3aNQKYq][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35994584/0c55c356cb08d6f262b81d57eb0e64c70728dd9e.png[/img][/url]

notes.title: Yokai dimension, Oni & stealth
notes.content:
Hey guys,

As you can see, we're not slowing down! Here's another update for your viewing pleasure. We're incredibly excited to share some more news with you!

[h2]Yokai dimension[/h2]
Combat is not just a straightforward mechanic in [b]Shadow of the Road[/b]. We're working on some features that will only apply while fighting in the yokai dimension. A small preview can be found below. We're still experimenting with those ideas, but we really like the way this is going!

[previewyoutube=F8UeVO5Uq20;full][/previewyoutube]

[h2]Oni - Ishida's yokai[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35994584/33b0b75223c5106c151eb5d5642fe6169ff52e2e.jpg[/img]

We have already shown you the yokai versions of Satoru and Asuke. Today we would like to show you [b]Ishida[/b]'s yokai form. We chose the name [b]Oni[/b] and even though it is usually associated wth regular demons, we wanted to add our own spin to it and make it relate to Ishida both in the way of looks and in the way of character. We can't share too much information about Ishida because we don't want to spoil the story, but you can be sure that the connection between Ishida and Oni is indeed a very interesting one.

[previewyoutube=lri-HjbCJEY;full][/previewyoutube]

[h2]Stealth mechanics[/h2]
We have not mentioned before that free exploration will not just be limited to travelling from point A to point B. While travelling you will have to make sure to keep a low profile in some locations as sneaking past your enemies could prove essential and sometimes even save your life. Sometimes being cautious is the best way to avoid unsuspecting enemies that would normally destroy you in an uneven match.
[previewyoutube=eGvcmYDvMak;full][/previewyoutube]


[h3][b]Join our discord server & see what will happen next![/b][/h3] 
Your insights are invaluable for us and it helps us to deliver something extraordinary.

tags.feature: Combat is not just a straightforward mechanic in [b]Shadow of the Road[/b]. We're working on some features that will only apply while fighting in the yokai dimension.

Today we would like to show you [b]Ishida[/b]'s yokai form. We chose the name [b]Oni[/b] and even though it is usually associated wth regular demons, we wanted to add our own spin to it and make it relate to Ishida both in the way of looks and in the way of character.
While travelling you will have to make sure to keep a low profile in some locations as sneaking past your enemies could prove essential and sometimes even save your life.

notes.title: New creatures & exploration mode update
notes.content:
Hey there! We have a special treat for you today that we hope you're going to enjoy. This is the first entry of a development update series in which we would like to highlight some of the things that we are currently working on. Please tell us if you enjoy such condensed posts and let us know if you would like to know more about any of these topics!

[h2]Kuchiberashi[/h2]
A newborn sacrificed by its parents, now acting as an ally for a more powerful entity. Constantly looking for something to eat. The creation itself has been inspired by different manifestations in the Japanese folklore but we decided to take a slightly different approach and create something unique for our game and setting.

[img]https://media.giphy.com/media/KEBFvYGexsq6Mb7Wui/source.gif[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35994584/a9bbe34b56ba798283fa5fdbe273871a97c62894.png[/img]

[h2]Exploration mode[/h2]
We've prototyped two separate control systems for wandering around in-game Japan.

One with direct control (using WSAD and a mouse):
[previewyoutube=C4xQvJfh8oA;full][/previewyoutube]

Another one based on the "Hand of God" (point & click) type of controls: 
[previewyoutube=qctoBfLyXAI;full][/previewyoutube]

Which one do you prefer? Be sure to leave a comment below or discuss it on our [url=http://bit.ly/3aNQKYq]Discord Server[/url].

[h2]Genkurō[/h2]
We do realize that white foxes are special entities in the Japanese folklore and are usually associated with the [i]kami Inari[/i] responsible for fertility, rice, tea and sake. However, our Genkurō is a spiritual guide that has more in common with the general concept of [i]kitsune[/i] - an intelligent being with paranormal abilities. You can be sure that even though his role is not clear throughout the beginning of the story he's definitely going to surprise you more than once.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35994584/ca0531d1cbe24dd6f7527b52140985c0dd4623b2.jpg[/img]

[h2]Kamaitachi[/h2]
It's finally time to present another yōkai - you met Jorōgumo some time ago and you were even able to view parts of gameplay featuring this strange arachnid entity. Kamaitachi however is a yōkai tied to our protagonist Satoru. Based on Japanese folklore Kamaitachi is a weasel-like entity with blades growing out of its arms. Kamaitachi is swift, light and usually associated with wind. Therefore we chose to include some smoke and wind currents in the design as well to bring out its magical nature even more.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35994584/4ef4f93e84692616bc855926e89db4cf481555a8.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35994584/77092b5ebdf15b21403cc418cb83e80ac32e313b.jpg[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35994584/229f06562d019725b82392288a21527c6eaa5ea6.png[/img]
